tests.description: Viewer bucket +° maps to negative model Z rotation. Both the model's auditBucketPose and v17 auditViewerPose return identical scene-unit clearances for all four samples, in desktop and mobile profiles.

tests.notes: If WebGL fails after context allocation, use fresh canvas for 2D, because context type cannot change on an existing canvas.
Fig. 7 is specifically an operation on a test fixture, not positive evidence of a standard open/closed two-finger jaw profile.
No live GPU rendering screenshot or mobile touch test. This run's browser lacks access to the published site from the sandbox.
No verified factory drawings or physical dimensions. Claims about actual travel limits remain prohibited.

limitations: A Three-compatible JavaScript mock is not a real GPU rendering test.
The 2D heatmap tests projected point clearance to nominal crawler level, not triangle mesh collisions.
Only the positive displayed lift sign and UI slider domain were synchronized; this does not validate the real electromechanical transmission geometry.
Programmatic screen-warning changes from v15 to v17 must not be interpreted as real safety improvements: sweep range and sign convention both changed.
Some external primary-domain assets can intermittently timeout; source bibliography remains intact.
Actual WebGL and Canvas2D graphics, phone performance and photo alignment need further real-device acceptance.

releaseGate.rationale: Release resolves a demonstrated interface-coordinate defect and improves source fidelity without inventing parts; browser rendering unverified and disclosed.
